verdict.rationale: Google publishes a dedicated rate-limits page and pricing tiers describing 'higher rate limits for production deployments,' confirming the docs exist and tiers are formalized (gemini-docs-17, gemini-docs-18/31). However, the evidence pack shows only high-level snippets (e.g. 'View your active rate limits in AI Studio') with no concrete RPM/TPM numbers, tier thresholds, or documented 429 error shape, and community reports (gemini-comm-1, gemini-comm-4) describe confusing, undocumented tier-qualification requirements (e.g. needing $250+ spend aged 30 days for Tier 1) that add real friction beyond what the docs make clear. Missing for 10: explicit per-tier RPM/TPM tables, a documented 429 response example/schema, and independent confirmation that the documented tier-scaling rules match real account experience.
